clues.text: Reaching a top speed of 35 mph and standing 65 feet tall, this family coaster features 0 inversions along its course.
This coaster was manufactured by Zierer and officially opened to park guests in 1995.
This themed attraction is located at a park in the state of California.
Located at Knott's Berry Farm, this coaster notably passes right through the vertical loop of another iconic roller coaster.
The ride shares its name with a large, spotted wild cat native to the Americas.

evidence.quote: Jaguar! is a steel family roller coaster at Knott's Berry Farm in Buena Park, California, United States.
The ride passes through the vertical loop of Montezooma's Revenge.
Straight ahead, there is giant stone tablet of some more Mayan Jaguar Warriors with the head of a jaguar.
